([GOD] only. Limit 1 per deck.) 
POWER: Search your Life Deck for a Styled card and place it into your hand. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Red Charged Balls
Text:
(You may only have one "Red Charged Balls" attached. If this card is banished from your Life Deck, attach it to your MP.) 
[ATTACK] 1: Energy attack. While attached, your Styled attacks deal+1 stage. 
[DESPERATION]: Raise your anger 2. 
DAMAGE: 3 stages. HIT: Rejuvenate 1. [ALIEN]: Rejuvenate 3 instead.

name: Red Deterrence
Text:
(If this card is banished from your Life Deck, destroy an opponent's Ally or attached card.) 
[DEFENSE] Stops a physical attack. 
Raise your anger 1. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Red Dismissal
Text:
(If this card is banished from your Life Deck, destroy an opponent's Setup or Drill.) 
[DEFENSE] Stops an energy attack. 
Raise your anger 1. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Red Escape
Text:
(You cannot win by MPPV the turn you play this card.) 
[DEFENSE] Stops an energy attack. 
Advance your MP one personality level. Lower your MP one personality level at the end of combat.

name: Red Left Bolt
Text:
[ATTACK] 3: Energy attack. 
Damage from this attack is banished. Draw the bottom card of your Life Deck. 
DAMAGE: 5 life cards. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Red Pacing Drill
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Your Styled attacks deal +1 stage. 
[INSTANT] POWER: Use after one of your effects lowers your anger. Raise your anger 1.

name: Red Precision Strike
Text:
[ATTACK] Physical attack. Focused. Raise your anger 1. 
[DESPERATION]: Rejuvenate X. X = your current anger level. 
DAMAGE: 5 stages. 
HIT: Banish X cards from your opponent's discard pile. X = your current anger level.

name: Red Relentless Mastery
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Your Styled attacks deal +1 stage. 
[INSTANT] POWER: Use when you perform an attack. Banish the top card of your Life Deck to make that attack Focused. If you banished a Styled card, raise your anger 1. 
POWER: Lower your anger by any amount. Rejuvenate X. X = the amount of anger you lowered.

name: Red Right Punch
Text:
[ATTACK] Physical attack. 
Search your Life Deck for X Drills and place them into play. X = your current anger level. 
DAMAGE: AT stages.

name: Red Tandem Attack
Text:
(if this card is discarded from your hand by an opponent's effect, draw a card and raise your anger 1.) 
[ATTACK] Physical attack. 
Raise your anger 1. If your opponent has 5 or more cards in their hand, draw a card. 
DAMAGE: AT +3 stages.

name: Saiyan Assault
Text:
[ATTACK] Physical attack. Gain 3 stages. 
[DESPERATION]: If you have only 1 Trait, Focused and raise your anger 2. 
DAMAGE: 6 stages. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Saiyan Defiant Mastery
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal +1 life card. 
[DEFENSE] POWER: Prevent all damage from an attack if you have 1 or less cards in your hand. Raise or lower a player's anger 1. 
POWER: Discard 2 cards fromy our hand to search your Life Deck for a Styled [DESPERATION] card and place it into your hand.

name: Saiyan Dive
Text:
(This card's Endurance is considered to be 10 for your card effects.) 
[ATTACK] Physical attack. 
You may banish 2 non-[ATTACK] cards from your discard pile. If you do, banish a Setup or Drill. 
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.

name: Saiyan Energy Flurry
Text:
[ATTACK] 2: Energy attack. Search your discard pile for a Styled card with Endurance and shuffle it into your Life Deck. 
[DESPERATION]: Remain 1. 
DAMAGE: 5 life cards. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Saiyan Enraged
Text:
POWER: Raise your anger 2. Rejuvenate the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile. If your MP's power level is higher than your opponent's MP's power level, draw a card. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Saiyan Overload Drill
Text:
(If this card is discarded from your hand during combat, you may play it.) 
[CONSTANT]: Whenever you perform a Styled attack, you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, that attack deals +X life cards. X = the amount of Endurance on the discarded card (to a maximum of 4).

name: Saiyan Refocus
Text:
(As an action, you may discard this card from your hand to perform a Styled energy attack dealing 3 life cards.) 
[DEFENSE] Stops an energy attack.

name: Saiyan Reversal
Text:
(As an action, you may discard this card from your hand to perform a Styled physical attack dealing 4 stages.) 
[DEFENSE] Stops a physical attack.

name: Saiyan Severing Punch
Text:
[ATTACK] Physical attack. 
Until the end of your next turn, your opponent cannot gain more than 1 anger from each card effect. 
DAMAGE: AT +4 stages. 
HIT: Until the end of your next turn, your opponent cannot use effects that advance or lower an MP 1 or more levels.

name: Shisami - Enforcer
Text: [CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal +1 stage. Attacks performed by personalities with [ALIEN] deal +1 life card.

name: Show of Force
Text:
([SAIYAN] only. Limit 1 per deck. Once per combat, you may shuffle this card from your hand into your Life Deck as an action to draw a card.) 
POWER: Destroy a Setup. 
[DESPERATION]: Destroy all Setups. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Skillful Parry
Text:
[DEFENSE] Stops a physical attack. 
Gain 5 stages.

(Banish after use.)

name: Sobering Hammer
Text:
[ATTACK] Physical attack. 
Search your Life Deck or discard pile for an Ally with a [CONSTANT] power and place it into play at 1 stage above 0. 
DAMAGE: 4 stages. 
HIT: Until the end of your next turn, effects that advance a personality 1 or more levels cannot be used.

name: Sorbet - Commander
Text:
POWER: [ATTACK] 2: Energy attack. 
DAMAGE: 1 life card. 
HIT: Search your Life Deck for an [ALIEN] Ally and play it.

name: Stare Down
Text:
(Villains only.) 
POWER: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card. Your opponent discards that card.

name: Super Dragon Ball 1
Text: Name a Setup, Drill, Ally, or attached card. Destroy all copies of that card in play.

name: Super Dragon Ball 2
Text: [[CONSTANT][: Your attacks deal +2 stages. The first time you use Endurance each combat, increase its value by 1.

name: Super Dragon Ball 3
Text: Draw a card. Banish 3 cards from your opponent's discard pile. Gain 3 stages.

name: Super Dragon Ball 4
Text: Shuffle up to 4 cards from your discard pile into your Life Deck.

name: Super Dragon Ball 5
Text: Raise your anger 1. Lower your opponent's anger 1. You may shuffle a Dragon Ball in play back into its owner's Life Deck.

name: Super Dragon Ball 6
Text: Choose a personality in play. That personality loses 3 stages. Lower your opponent's anger 3.

name: Super Dragon Ball 7
Text: (Once per game, you may play this card from your hand as an action to draw a card.) Use a critical damage effect.

name: Tagoma - Tough as Nails
Text: [CONSTANT]: After taking damage from an attack, banish the top or bottom card of your opponent's discard pile.

name: The Spirit of Earth
Text:
([EARTHLING] only. Limit 1 per deck.)

(Banish after use.)

name: Utter Destruction
